seo.title: Free Food Log for Personal Training Clients | Caltrac AI
seo.description: See what your personal training clients eat between sessions, from their own photo or text logs, and comment on meals. Free to join.
seo.h1: See what your clients eat between sessions, free

hero.intro: Caltrac AI for Professionals lets personal trainers see the meals their clients choose to share, and comment on the ones worth talking about. Clients log with a photo or a short description, and they decide what you see.

items.title: When progress slows.
items.text: Look at what a client has actually been logging, instead of relying on what they remember.

items.title: Short, specific feedback.
items.text: Comment on a single meal. Your client reads it in the app, next to the food.

items.title: Less typing for you.
items.text: Calories and macros are estimated for each meal, so you spend your time reading and replying.

getClients.heading: Get your clients on Caltrac AI
getClients.body: Apply (free, reviewed within 24–48 hours), get your linking code and give it to your clients. They enter it in Caltrac Connect and send you a request; access starts when you accept it.

steps.text: For example, a client trains with you on Monday and Thursday.
In between, they log meals with a photo or a short description.
Before Thursday you open the meals they have shared, pick the ones worth discussing and comment on them, so the session starts from what they actually ate.

items.question: Can I see a client's meals before they accept?
items.answer: No. Access starts only when the client enters your code and sends a request, and you accept it.

items.question: What can I do with a meal?
items.answer: Read it and comment on it.

items.question: Do my clients need an iPhone?
items.answer: No. Caltrac AI is on iPhone and Android.

items.question: Can I comment on a meal before a session?
items.answer: Yes. Comment on any meal a client has shared. They read it in the app, next to the food.

items.question: What if a client stops sharing?
items.answer: Your access to their meals ends immediately. They don't need approval from you or from Caltrac AI.
